name: FamilyTreeNow
summary: Shows relatives, historical addresses, and property records — deeply linked.
detail: Public records aggregator with a focus on family tree data. Especially good for relatives mapping and historical address chains. Very useful for finding subjects who have moved frequently.
howTo: Review the relatives list — this often reveals siblings, parents, and children
proTip: Pair with TruePeopleSearch — FamilyTreeNow often has older records, TruePeopleSearch has more current data.

name: That's Them
summary: Multi-vector people search — name, email, phone, IP, VIN.
detail: Searches name, email, phone number, IP address, and VIN. The IP address lookup can reveal the physical address associated with an IP registered to a home ISP. Free but limited.
howTo: Select search type from the top navigation

name: Radaris
summary: Aggregates public records, news, and social data for individuals.
detail: Comprehensive people aggregator covering US public records, news mentions, social media, and business records. More thorough than most free tools but shows limited data without a paid report.
howTo: Search by name with state filter

name: Yandex People Search
summary: Russian-language people search — essential for CIS region subjects.
detail: Yandex's people search covers VK, OK, and Russian social networks. Significantly more effective than Western tools for subjects from Russia, Ukraine, Belarus, and Central Asia.
howTo: Enter name in Cyrillic or Latin script

name: WhatsMyName
summary: Checks 500+ sites for a username — the definitive username OSINT tool.
detail: Web interface for the WhatsMyName database, maintained by Webbreacher. Checks a username against 500+ platforms and displays results as found/not found. More accurate than most alternatives because ea…
howTo: Enter the target username exactly as it appears
Wait for all checks to complete (30-60 seconds)
proTip: The underlying data is open source on GitHub — you can run it locally with more control.

name: Sherlock
summary: CLI tool that hunts for a username across 400+ social networks.
detail: Popular open-source CLI tool. Checks a username against 400+ platforms and outputs a list of URLs where the account was found. Saves results to a text file automatically.
proTip: Run with multiple username variations in one command: sherlock user1 user2 user3

name: Maigret
summary: Advanced username OSINT — extracts profile data, not just presence.
detail: More powerful than Sherlock — checks 2500+ sites and extracts actual profile data (name, bio, location, join date) rather than just confirming existence. Generates HTML reports with linked accounts gr…
proTip: The -a flag runs the extended scan across all 2500+ sites. Takes longer but surfaces far more data.

name: Socialscan
summary: Accurate CLI username/email checker with zero false positives.
detail: Checks username and email availability by directly querying registration and password-reset endpoints. More accurate than web scraping — no false positives. Supports email and username simultaneously.

name: KnowEm
summary: Checks username across 500+ networks and domain registrars.
detail: Searches username across social networks, micro-blogging sites, and domain registrars. Taken = a profile likely exists. Good for quick broad-spectrum sweep.
howTo: Scan across the Social Networks, Micro Blogs, and Domains tabs

name: Namechk
summary: Fast username/domain check across social platforms and registrars.
detail: Instant availability check across major social platforms and domain registrars. Taken = profile exists. Fast first-pass tool before running deeper tools.

name: Epieos
summary: Email lookup revealing Google Account details and linked services.
detail: Enter an email and Epieos reveals the linked Google Account name, profile photo, Google Maps reviews, Calendar events, and other public Google-linked data. Extremely powerful for Gmail addresses.
howTo: View linked Google Account name and photo if present
proTip: Google Maps reviews often reveal the subject's home neighborhood, workplace, and regular locations.

name: Holehe
summary: Checks if an email is registered on 120+ services via password-reset probing.
detail: Uses password-reset endpoint probing to determine if an email is registered on each platform — without logging in. Highly accurate with minimal false positives. Supports 120+ sites.

name: Have I Been Pwned
summary: The canonical breach database — 13B+ compromised accounts.
detail: Troy Hunt's authoritative breach notification service. Checks an email or phone against 750+ breaches and paste sites. Tells you which breaches it appeared in and what data was exposed (but not the ac…
howTo: Enter the email or phone number

name: MXToolbox Email Headers
summary: Parse email headers to trace routing and identify sender origin.
detail: Parses raw email headers and displays the full routing path hop-by-hop. Identifies the originating IP address, mail server software, and timing of each relay. Critical for email forensics.
howTo: Open the email in your client
Access raw headers: Gmail → three dots → Show Original; Outlook → File → Properties
proTip: For Gmail, the X-Originating-IP header directly reveals the sender's IP if they used a desktop client rather than webmai…

name: Hunter.io Email Verifier
summary: Verify email deliverability and check if a mailbox exists.
detail: Checks email format, domain MX records, and SMTP server response to verify a mailbox exists. Returns a deliverability score and status. 25 free verifications per month.
howTo: Review the verification result (Valid, Invalid, Risky, Unknown)

name: Emailrep.io
summary: Scores email reputation — flags suspicious, disposable, or high-risk addresses.
detail: Returns a reputation score and risk flags for any email address: disposable, free provider, data breach history, malicious activity reports. Useful for assessing the risk profile of an unknown sender.

name: h8mail
summary: CLI breach hunter supporting multiple data breach APIs.
detail: Queries multiple breach databases (HIBP, DeHashed, etc.) for an email address and returns breach data including exposed passwords where available. Configure API keys for full coverage.

name: Phonebook.cz
summary: Searches breach databases for email, domain, and URL data.
detail: Searches through leaked databases for email addresses, domains, and URLs. Useful for finding all email addresses associated with a domain, or checking breach exposure. Free account provides limited re…
howTo: Select search type: email, domain, or URL

name: PhoneInfoga
summary: Advanced framework for scanning phone numbers using public sources.
detail: Comprehensive phone number OSINT framework. Identifies country, carrier, line type (mobile/landline/VoIP), and runs the number through multiple search engines and databases. Has both a CLI and a self-…
howTo: Install via Docker: docker run --rm -it sundowndev/phoneinfoga scan -n +1XXXXXXXXXX
Or install from pip: pip install phoneinfoga
proTip: The web UI renders a beautiful report. Run: docker run -it -p 8080:8080 sundowndev/phoneinfoga serve

name: Ignorant
summary: Checks if a phone number is linked to Snapchat, Instagram, and others.
detail: Uses password-reset endpoint probing to check if a phone number is registered on Snapchat, Instagram, and other platforms. No login required. Accurate with minimal false positives.

name: CarrierLookup
summary: Identifies carrier and line type (mobile/landline/VoIP) for US numbers.
detail: Free US carrier lookup. Identifies the carrier (Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile, etc.) and line type. VoIP result indicates a virtual number — check further with Google Voice, TextNow, or similar service look…
howTo: Note the carrier and line type
proTip: A Google Voice number will show as 'Google' carrier with VoIP type. TextNow shows as Telcobridges.
